properties.description: End-to-end cab trip ingestion: generate raw data (notebook) -> clean (Spark job) -> load stage/dims/fact (stored procs) and build summary (Spark job) -> validate (stored proc + notebook).

RunMessage.value: One or more ingestion activities failed; see the pipeline run in Synapse Monitor.

properties.description: Master orchestration pipeline for the Synapse to Fabric migration accelerator ecosystem.
Assess real TransportDW SQL objects used by the Synapse migration accelerator.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT 'stage.NYCCabTrip_Green' AS ObjectName, COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount] FROM [stage].[NYCCabTrip_Green]
SELECT 'stage.NYCCabTrip_Yellow' AS ObjectName, COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount] FROM [stage].[NYCCabTrip_Yellow]
SELECT 'dw.DimCabType' AS ObjectName, COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount] FROM [dw].[DimCabType]
SELECT 'dw.DimLocation' AS ObjectName, COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount] FROM [dw].[DimLocation]
SELECT 'dw.DimPaymentType' AS ObjectName, COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount] FROM [dw].[DimPaymentType]
SELECT 'dw.DimRate' AS ObjectName, COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount] FROM [dw].[DimRate]
SELECT 'dw.DimTripType' AS ObjectName, COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount] FROM [dw].[DimTripType]
SELECT 'dw.DimVendor' AS ObjectName, COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount] FROM [dw].[DimVendor]
SELECT 'dw.FactCabTrip' AS ObjectName, COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount] FROM [dw].[FactCabTrip]

properties.description: Validate row counts and connectivity across TransportDW staging and warehouse tables.
Serverless SQL assessment: OPENROWSET over the CSV and Parquet sales files produced by PL_Spark_Test; fails if they do not reconcile.

scripts.text:
SELECT 'CSV' AS TestType, COUNT(*) AS [RowCount]
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://externalstgaccmigration.dfs.core.windows.net/migrationcontainer/migration-test/csv/sales/*.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV', PARSER_VERSION = '2.0', HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PARQUET', COUNT(*)
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://externalstgaccmigration.dfs.core.windows.net/migrationcontainer/migration-test/parquet/sales/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS rows;

properties.description: Spark assessment: generate sales/customer CSV + Parquet, transform to a city/product summary, reconcile CSV vs Parquet counts and copy the summary into the dedicated pool.

message.value: @concat('CSV/Parquet reconciliation failed. sales csv=', string(activity('Count_CSV_Sales').output.count), ' parquet=', string(activity('Count_Parquet_Sales').output.count), '; customers csv=', string(activity('Count_CSV_Customers').output.count), ' parquet=', string(activity('Count_Parquet_Customers').output.count), '; summary rows copied=', string(activity('Copy_Sales_Summary_To_SQL').output.rowsCopied))

properties.description: External ADLS Gen2 account for the migration project (replaces transportationsynapsemigration-WorkspaceDefaultStorage -> migrationmk).
Built-in serverless SQL pool of transportationmigration (workspace managed identity).

content.query:
-- Serverless SQL test: CSV generated by NB_Read_Raw_Data
SELECT TOP 100 *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://externalstgaccmigration.dfs.core.windows.net/migrationcontainer/migration-test/csv/sales/*.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS rows;

-- Validation script for the migration test ecosystem.
-- Run against the Built-in/serverless SQL pool after PL_Spark_Test has completed.
SELECT 'CSV' AS TestType, COUNT(*) AS [RowCount]
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://externalstgaccmigration.dfs.core.windows.net/migrationcontainer/migration-test/csv/sales/*.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS rows;

SELECT 'PARQUET' AS TestType, COUNT(*) AS [RowCount]
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://externalstgaccmigration.dfs.core.windows.net/migrationcontainer/migration-test/parquet/sales/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS rows;

properties.description: Cleans raw green/yellow cab trip CSVs into curated Parquet (stage-table column order) plus the taxi zone lookup.
Builds a daily trip summary (cab type x pickup borough) from curated cab trip Parquet.

source:
# Generate deterministic, internally consistent NYC green/yellow cab trips (Jan-Mar 2019) as raw CSV,
# plus a taxi zone lookup based on real NYC TLC zone IDs.
#
# Business rules (2019 TLC tariff, simplified):
#   * standard meter: $2.50 + $2.50/mile + $0.35/minute, rounded to $0.50; JFK<->Manhattan flat $52;
#     Newark = meter + $17.50; negotiated fares are rare
#   * extra $0.50 overnight (20:00-06:00), $1.00 weekday peak (16:00-20:00); MTA tax $0.50; improvement $0.30
#   * congestion surcharge $2.75 only from 2019-02-01 and only for trips touching Manhattan's Yellow Zone
#   * tips only on credit card payments (payment_type 1)
#   * green cabs pick up outside Manhattan's Yellow Zone
#   * total_amount = fare + extra + mta_tax + tip + tolls + improvement + congestion
# Deliberate dirty data for JBD_Process_Cab_Data to clean: ~1% missing pickup time, ~1% negative fare,
# ~1% exact duplicate rows. Same seed => same rows every run, so Synapse vs Fabric results can be compared.
import random
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

base = f"abfss://{container}@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net/migration-test/nyccab"
rnd = random.Random(seed)

zones = [
    (1, "EWR", "Newark Airport", "EWR"),
    (4, "Manhattan", "Alphabet City", "Yellow Zone"),
    (5, "Staten Island", "Arden Heights", "Boro Zone"),
    (7, "Queens", "Astoria", "Boro Zone"),
    (13, "Manhattan", "Battery Park City", "Yellow Zone"),
    (24, "Manhattan", "Bloomingdale", "Yellow Zone"),
    (33, "Brooklyn", "Brooklyn Heights", "Boro Zone"),
    (41, "Manhattan", "Central Harlem", "Boro Zone"),
    (42, "Manhattan", "Central Harlem North", "Boro Zone"),
    (43, "Manhattan", "Central Park", "Yellow Zone"),
    (48, "Manhattan", "Clinton East", "Yellow Zone"),
    (65, "Brooklyn", "Downtown Brooklyn/MetroTech", "Boro Zone"),
    (66, "Brooklyn", "DUMBO/Vinegar Hill", "Boro Zone"),
    (68, "Manhattan", "East Chelsea", "Yellow Zone"),
    (74, "Manhattan", "East Harlem North", "Boro Zone"),
    (75, "Manhattan", "East Harlem South", "Boro Zone"),
    (79, "Manhattan", "East Village", "Yellow Zone"),
    (82, "Queens", "Elmhurst", "Boro Zone"),
    (87, "Manhattan", "Financial District North", "Yellow Zone"),
    (88, "Manhattan", "Financial District South", "Yellow Zone"),
    (97, "Brooklyn", "Fort Greene", "Boro Zone"),
    (112, "Brooklyn", "Greenpoint", "Boro Zone"),
    (113, "Manhattan", "Greenwich Village North", "Yellow Zone"),
    (114, "Manhattan", "Greenwich Village South", "Yellow Zone"),
    (129, "Queens", "Jackson Heights", "Boro Zone"),
    (132, "Queens", "JFK Airport", "Airports"),
    (138, "Queens", "LaGuardia Airport", "Airports"),
    (140, "Manhattan", "Lenox Hill East", "Yellow Zone"),
    (141, "Manhattan", "Lenox Hill West", "Yellow Zone"),
    (142, "Manhattan", "Lincoln Square East", "Yellow Zone"),
    (161, "Manhattan", "Midtown Center", "Yellow Zone"),
    (162, "Manhattan", "Midtown East", "Yellow Zone"),
    (166, "Manhattan", "Morningside Heights", "Boro Zone"),
    (168, "Bronx", "Mott Haven/Port Morris", "Boro Zone"),
    (170, "Manhattan", "Murray Hill", "Yellow Zone"),
    (181, "Brooklyn", "Park Slope", "Boro Zone"),
    (186, "Manhattan", "Penn Station/Madison Sq West", "Yellow Zone"),
    (230, "Manhattan", "Times Sq/Theatre District", "Yellow Zone"),
    (236, "Manhattan", "Upper East Side North", "Yellow Zone"),
    (237, "Manhattan", "Upper East Side South", "Yellow Zone"),
    (238, "Manhattan", "Upper West Side North", "Yellow Zone"),
    (239, "Manhattan", "Upper West Side South", "Yellow Zone"),
    (244, "Manhattan", "Washington Heights South", "Boro Zone"),
    (247, "Bronx", "West Concourse", "Boro Zone"),
    (255, "Brooklyn", "Williamsburg (North Side)", "Boro Zone"),
    (256, "Brooklyn", "Williamsburg (South Side)", "Boro Zone"),
    (260, "Queens", "Woodside", "Boro Zone"),
]
zone_by_id = {z[0]: z for z in zones}
yellow_zone_ids = [z[0] for z in zones if z[3] == "Yellow Zone"]
boro_zone_ids = [z[0] for z in zones if z[3] == "Boro Zone"]
outer_zone_ids = [z[0] for z in zones if z[3] in ("Boro Zone", "Airports")]
all_zone_ids = [z[0] for z in zones]
JFK, LGA, EWR = 132, 138, 1
CONGESTION_START = datetime(2019, 2, 1)


def money(x):
    return f"{x:.2f}"


def touches_congestion_zone(pu, do):
    return zone_by_id[pu][3] == "Yellow Zone" or zone_by_id[do][3] == "Yellow Zone"


def pick_zones(cab_type):
    if cab_type == "green":
        pu = rnd.choice(boro_zone_ids)  # green cabs cannot pick up in Manhattan's Yellow Zone or at airports
    else:
        pu = rnd.choice(yellow_zone_ids) if rnd.random() < 0.85 else rnd.choice([JFK, LGA] + outer_zone_ids)
    r = rnd.random()
    if r < 0.05:
        do = JFK
    elif r < 0.08:
        do = LGA
    elif r < 0.09:
        do = EWR
    else:
        do = rnd.choice(all_zone_ids)
    return pu, do


def make_trip(cab_type):
    pu, do = pick_zones(cab_type)
    pickup = datetime(2019, 1, 1) + timedelta(minutes=rnd.randint(0, 60 * 24 * 90 - 1))

    manhattan_jfk = JFK in (pu, do) and "Manhattan" in (zone_by_id[pu][1], zone_by_id[do][1])
    if manhattan_jfk:
        rate_code, distance = 2, rnd.uniform(15.0, 21.0)
    elif EWR in (pu, do):
        rate_code, distance = 3, rnd.uniform(14.0, 24.0)
    elif rnd.random() < 0.01:
        rate_code, distance = 5, rnd.uniform(2.0, 15.0)
    else:
        rate_code = 1
        distance = rnd.uniform(8.0, 14.0) if LGA in (pu, do) or JFK in (pu, do) else rnd.uniform(0.4, 9.0)
    distance = round(distance, 2)

    speed_mph = rnd.uniform(7.0, 22.0)
    minutes = max(2, round(distance / speed_mph * 60))
    dropoff = pickup + timedelta(minutes=minutes)

    meter = round((2.5 + 2.5 * distance + 0.35 * minutes) * 2) / 2
    if rate_code == 2:
        fare = 52.0
    elif rate_code == 3:
        fare = meter + 17.5
    elif rate_code == 5:
        fare = float(rnd.randint(20, 80))
    else:
        fare = meter

    hour = pickup.hour
    if hour >= 20 or hour < 6:
        extra = 0.5
    elif 16 <= hour < 20 and pickup.weekday() < 5:
        extra = 1.0
    else:
        extra = 0.0
    mta_tax, improvement = 0.5, 0.3
    tolls = 5.76 if rate_code in (2, 3) and rnd.random() < 0.6 else 0.0
    congestion = 2.75 if pickup >= CONGESTION_START and touches_congestion_zone(pu, do) else 0.0

    payment_type = rnd.choices([1, 2, 3, 4], weights=[65, 32, 2, 1])[0]
    tip = round((fare + extra) * rnd.choice([0.0, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25]), 2) if payment_type == 1 else 0.0
    total = fare + extra + mta_tax + tip + tolls + improvement + congestion

    row = {
        "VendorID": str(rnd.choice([1, 2])),
        "lpep_pickup_datetime": pickup.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "lpep_dropoff_datetime": dropoff.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "store_and_fwd_flag": "Y" if rnd.random() < 0.01 else "N",
        "RatecodeID": str(rate_code),
        "PULocationID": str(pu),
        "DOLocationID": str(do),
        "passenger_count": str(rnd.choices([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], weights=[70, 15, 5, 2, 5, 3])[0]),
        "trip_distance": money(distance),
        "fare_amount": money(fare),
        "extra": money(extra),
        "mta_tax": money(mta_tax),
        "tip_amount": money(tip),
        "tolls_amount": money(tolls),
        "ehail_fee": "",
        "improvement_surcharge": money(improvement),
        "total_amount": money(total),
        "payment_type": str(payment_type),
        "trip_type": "2" if rnd.random() < 0.03 else "1",
        "congestion_surcharge": money(congestion),
    }

    # ~1% missing pickup time, ~1% negative fare (bad meter reading) -> removed by JBD_Process_Cab_Data
    r = rnd.random()
    if r < 0.01:
        row["lpep_pickup_datetime"] = ""
    elif r < 0.02:
        row["fare_amount"] = money(-fare)
        row["total_amount"] = money(-total)

    if cab_type == "yellow":
        row.pop("ehail_fee")
        row.pop("trip_type")
    return row


def make_trips(cab_type):
    trips = [make_trip(cab_type) for _ in range(num_trips)]
    # ~1% exact duplicates (double-submitted records) -> removed by dropDuplicates in JBD_Process_Cab_Data
    trips += [dict(trips[i]) for i in rnd.sample(range(num_trips), num_trips // 100)]
    return trips


green = make_trips("green")
yellow = make_trips("yellow")

green_df = spark.createDataFrame(green).select(list(green[0].keys()))
yellow_df = spark.createDataFrame(yellow).select(list(yellow[0].keys()))
zones_df = spark.createDataFrame(
    [(str(z[0]), z[1], z[2], z[3]) for z in zones], ["LocationID", "Borough", "Zone", "service_zone"]
)

green_df.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").option("header", "true").csv(base + "/raw/green")
yellow_df.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").option("header", "true").csv(base + "/raw/yellow")
zones_df.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").option("header", "true").csv(base + "/raw/taxi_zone_lookup")

print(f"Raw data written to {base}/raw: green={len(green)}, yellow={len(yellow)}, zones={len(zones)}")

# Generate migration-test source data.
storage = "abfss://migrationcontainer@externalstgaccmigration.dfs.core.windows.net"

customers = [
    ("C001", "Asha", "Hyderabad"),
    ("C002", "Ravi", "Vijayawada"),
    ("C003", "Priya", "Bengaluru"),
    ("C004", "Arjun", "Chennai")
]

sales = [
    ("S001", "C001", "Laptop", 65000),
    ("S002", "C002", "Phone", 30000),
    ("S003", "C001", "Monitor", 18000),
    ("S004", "C003", "Keyboard", 2500),
    ("S005", "C004", "Laptop", 72000)
]

customers_df = spark.createDataFrame(
    customers,
    ["CustomerId", "CustomerName", "City"]

# Validate the Spark outputs of PL_Cab_Data_Ingestion: curated trips and daily summary must reconcile.
import json
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = f"abfss://{container}@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net/migration-test/nyccab"

green = spark.read.parquet(base + "/curated/green")
yellow = spark.read.parquet(base + "/curated/yellow")
summary = spark.read.parquet(base + "/summary/daily_trip_summary")

curated_rows = green.count() + yellow.count()
summary_trips = summary.agg(F.sum("TripCount")).collect()[0][0] or 0
null_pickups = green.filter(F.col("lpep_pickup_datetime").isNull()).count() + \
               yellow.filter(F.col("lpep_pickup_datetime").isNull()).count()

result = {
    "curated_rows": curated_rows,
    "summary_trips": int(summary_trips),
    "null_pickups": null_pickups,
}
print(result)

errors = []
if curated_rows == 0:
    errors.append("curated data is empty")
if curated_rows != summary_trips:
    errors.append(f"summary trips {summary_trips} != curated rows {curated_rows}")
if null_pickups:
    errors.append(f"{null_pickups} curated rows have null pickup time")
if errors:
    raise ValueError("Validation failed: " + "; ".join(errors))

mssparkutils.notebook.exit(json.dumps(result))
